body: @llama-nl Thanks for testing! That looks like two different builds - is the same project built twice, failing differently each time? Or, two different projects? Does it happen with a super minimal project as well?

@dsnopek both are same project. 

I had a demo project. I just install the android_source from project settings then export apk with gradle.

@llama-nl I tried building your project on my Quest 3, and it was able to build successfully

Is there anything interesting in the `adb logcat` that could maybe point to the problem?

Also, what Android version is your device?

Looking at your specific errors, I have a couple of random guesses:

- The 1st error could maybe be caused by running out of disk space. How much free disk space do you have available on the device?
- The 2nd error could maybe be related to internet connectivity. Was your device connected to the internet? Are you able to reach the Google DNS servers (`8.8.8.8`, `8.8.4.4`, `2001:4860:4860::6464` and `2001:4860:4860::64`) from your device? I hard-coded the Linux rootfs to use Google's DNS servers, which is why I'm specifically asking about those. :-) If they turn out to be a problem, I'll need to come up with another solution for that

One more thing I noticed: whenever I export the project, files like Gradle and other dependencies are downloaded again each time. Is there a way to cache these files so they can be reused on the next export instead of downloading them again and again.

@llama-nl Thanks for testing!

Gradle build is confirmed to work on a number of Android devices (my Huion Tablet, Quest 3 and Pico 4), but there seem to be some issues on other devices. We'll get to the bottom of it soon, I hope!

> One more thing I noticed: whenever I export the project, files like Gradle and other dependencies are downloaded again each time. Is there a way to cache these files so they can be reused on the next export instead of downloading them again and again.

This is a caveat I put in the original PR description. It's something I'm planning to fix in the build environment app before Godot 4.6 stable is released

@llama-nl I have a theory about the error that you're getting - try with this new APK for the build environment app:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YFTL-SsVAfx7zCS7_fmuA9cRL7kY5JOz/view?usp=sharing

You'll need to use the button in the build environment app to delete and then re-install the rootfs, because I've made a change to it.

Please let me know if that fixes the issue for you!
